message: So, the other night I was making dinner and, as usual, got a little too engrossed in my favorite podcast. Suddenly, the smoke alarm went off! 😳 Instead of panicking, I remembered my escape plan and where to meet up outside. Turns out, I had just burnt the garlic bread, but it felt good to know I was prepared for anything. Sometimes, just having a plan can turn a small kitchen mishap into a win! Do you have an escape route mapped out?
